Add 1 tsp of dried herbs to 1 cup of water.  Bring to a boil, remove from heat and let steep for 10 - 15 minutes.

Promotes microbial balance within the digestive tract

products.title: Gut Blanket
products.body_html:
Slippery Elm & Marshmallow Root Soothing Blend

A gentle, grounding herbal blend traditionally used to support and comfort the digestive and respiratory systems. Slippery elm and marshmallow root are both known for their naturally soothing, mucilage-rich properties that coat and calm irritated tissues, making this blend a staple for everyday wellness rituals.

This formula is ideal for those seeking gentle internal support, especially when the body needs a soft, nurturing touch.

Key Benefits

Traditionally used to soothe and calm the digestive tract

Supports a healthy, comfortable gut environment

Naturally rich in plant mucilage that helps coat and protect internal tissues

Gentle support for throat and respiratory comfort

Ideal for sensitive systems and daily wellness routines

How to Take

Add 1 teaspoon to 8–12 oz of water and refrigerate overnight.

Add 1 teaspoon to 8–12 oz of warm (not hot) water and stir well. Let sit for 2–3 minutes to activate the natural mucilage, then drink slowly.

Can be taken:

  • 1–2 times daily as needed
  • Best taken between meals or before bed for soothing support

Mix thoroughly—this blend naturally thickens when activated with liquid.

Ingredients

Organic Slippery Elm Bark, Organic Marshmallow Root

Wellness Note

Use within three days. This is a traditional herbal preparation used for centuries in herbal wellness practices. It is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
